notes: ScaleDown 3.0.1: native Decision V4 choice, boolean and score, plus Extraction V4 text and lists of text. x-api-key and SCALEDOWN_API_KEY, lazy async credentials, custom base URL/headers, PDF/JPEG/PNG/TIFF evidence, confidence/legend/cost metadata, strict response validation, UTF-8 byte offsets converted to verified UTF-16 sources and OCR file citations. Other extraction fields and model families are explicitly rejected; JS workflow serialization is outside Swift.
